tools.name: animation_physics

actorName.description: Target actor name in the current level.

addMissing.description: Whether to add the morph target when the component does not already carry it.

assets.description: Canonical /Game animation asset paths to retarget.

automaticRule.description: Fire the transition when the source state's sequence player reaches the end of its animation instead of testing a condition. Left alone when omitted.

axis.description: Mirror or blend axis (X, Y, Z).

basePoseFrame.description: Frame used as the additive base pose.

basePoseType.description: Additive base pose type (RefPose, AnimScaled, AnimFrame).

bidirectional.description: Whether the transition also applies from toState back to fromState. Left alone when omitted.

bodyForAll.description: Create a body for every bone regardless of size.

bodyType.description: Physics body primitive type (Sphere, Box, Capsule).

conditionVariable.description: Animation Blueprint variable the transition rule tests, e.g. Speed or bFalling. Without it the rule graph is left unconnected, which reads as false forever and the state machine never leaves its entry state.

connectToOutput.description: Wire the blend node into the AnimGraph output pose (default true).

constraintName.description: Name of the created physics constraint.

crossfadeDuration.description: Transition blend duration in seconds. blendTime is accepted as an alias.

edit.description: Which configure anim graph node variant to run.

element.description: Which remove skeleton element variant to run.

endFrame.description: Last frame of the notify state range.

forceRootLock.description: Whether root motion is force-locked to the reference pose.

geomType.description: Body primitive: Sphyl, Box, Sphere, TaperedCapsule, MultiConvexHull or SingleConvexHull.

ragdoll.description: Which setup ragdoll variant to run; omit for 'setup'.

tools.name: control_editor
tools.description: Start/stop PIE, control viewport camera, run console commands, take screenshots, simulate input.

actorName.description: Name of the actor to target.

arguments.description: Argument values keyed by parameter name. Converted per-property, so structs and arrays are accepted in their JSON form. Omitted parameters keep their zero-initialised default and are listed in unsetParameters.

blendTime.description: Blend time in seconds for set_view_target.

cameraOp.description: Which set camera variant to run; omit for 'transform'.

classPath.description: Alias for className, the spelling the rest of the catalog uses.

control.description: Which play variant to run; omit for 'play'.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before restarting, so the response reaches the caller first. Clamped to 0.1-30.

deltaTime.description: Seconds every frame advances the running game, however long the frame really took (deterministic runs); 0 turns fixed stepping off. It also ends when PIE stops.

discardUnsaved.description: Restart even though packages have unsaved changes, discarding them. Omitted, a restart with unsaved work is refused.

filter.description: Case-sensitive substring matched against function names.

fov.description: Camera field of view in degrees.

functionName.description: Function name exactly as reported by describe_reflected_api.

history.description: Which undo variant to run; omit for 'undo'.

holdSeconds.description: Keep injecting inputAction, or keep a raw key_down/key_tap key pressed, for this many seconds of GAME time so the pawn actually travels (default 0: an action lasts one frame, a key_down stays down until key_up, a key_tap lets go after 0.1s). Game time, not wall time: under set_game_speed 0.05 a 2s hold still delivers 2s of in-game input, which takes 40s of real time. A key_up for the same action or key stops the hold early.

includeMetadata.description: Attach caller-provided metadata to the response.

inputAction.description: Enhanced Input action to inject directly, as an asset path such as /Game/Input/IA_Move. A raw key already reaches Enhanced Input through the active mapping contexts (key_down D moves a pawn whose context maps D); use inputAction when no key is mapped to the action, or to inject an analog value.

inputType.description: Alias for type used by simulate_input.

mode.description: Editor mode for set_editor_mode, or screenshot source.

name.description: Name identifier.

resolution.description: Maximum WxH for the returned PNG (e.g. "1280x720"). The capture is downscaled to fit inside this box with its aspect ratio preserved; a box at least as large as the viewport leaves the image untouched. Use this to bring an oversized capture under the base64 limit.

returnBase64.description: Return PNG image data as base64. Defaults to false — a plain capture returns path + metadata. Set true for inline image data; pair with resolution= (e.g. "1280x720") to keep the PNG under the base64 size cap.

setting.description: Which configure editor variant to run.

speed.description: Clock multiplier for the running game: 1 is normal, 0.05 runs it twenty times slower (above 0, up to 20).

stat.description: Stat name to show or hide.

tabId.description: Registered nomad tab id, for example "BridgeTab" (Quixel Bridge); "Fab" opens a new Fab tab.

type.description: Input event type (key_down, key_up, key_tap = press then release, mouse_click, mouse_move), or widget_list / widget_click to operate the live UMG of a PIE session.

validateOnly.description: Report whether a restart would proceed, and what it would discard, without restarting.

value.description: Scalar value to inject for inputAction (default 1; use a negative value for the opposite direction), or the value to set a Slider to with widget_click. Ignored for a raw key.

viewMode.description: Viewport view mode (e.g. Lit, Unlit, Wireframe).

widget.description: For type widget_click: the live UMG widget to drive, by name (PlayButton), or Owner.Name (WBP_MainMenu.PlayButton) when several share it. widget_list shows both.
